Incomplete silver washed Roman radiate or nummus, of Constantine I, probably of AD 318-320. RIC VII, 181. Obverse: radiate bust, likely draped and cuirassed. Legend:[---]STAN TINVS IVN [N]C. Reverse: two victories standing facing each other holding shield inscribed VOT/PR over altar. Alter side has a wreath surrounding a star. Legend: [VICTORIAE L]AETA EPRINC PERP. Mint: P[LN?].
